name: Basic Scan
description: Performs a basic scan on a single target URL.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting wafw00f 1.0.0
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Checking for WAF on http://www.imperva.com
[1m[32m[SUCCESS][0m The site http://www.imperva.com is protected by [1m[36mIncapsula[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Scan finished.

name: Scan with Verbose Output
description: Increases verbosity to show more details about the requests and responses.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting wafw00f 1.0.0
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Checking for WAF on http://www.imperva.com
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Verbose mode enabled. Trying a request with a malicious payload...
[1m[32m[SUCCESS][0m The site http://www.imperva.com is protected by [1m[36mIncapsula[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Scan finished.

name: Scan with Target List
description: Scans multiple targets from a provided file.
example_output:

name: List All WAFs

example_output:

name: Target Not Protected
description: Shows the output for a target that is not protected by a known WAF.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting wafw00f 1.0.0
